root_cause: One classification mistake shared by intent but not by code: window spans live in OPENING_SPAN, so the second form (WALL_FACE x H - window rectangles + lintels + heads) loses the wall plane through every window and then also deducts the window rectangle; windows have no below-sill / above-head surfaces at all in V1.
detail: WF-O1: V1 computes its second form as WALL_FACE x H - window deductions + lintels + head faces, but WALL_FACE excludes the window spans (they are booked as OPENING_SPAN): the wall plane across a window is dropped AND the window rectangle is deducted, and a window gets neither a below-sill nor an above-head surface. The primary form (gross plane incl. opening spans - rectangles) is right. The synthetic window test asserted the area of the primary form, never state == COMPUTED - that is how WF-O1 passed the freeze
v1_failure_on_a_synthetic_window: test_r8_18_wall_faces_v2::test_22 runs the frozen V1 on the same window fixture and asserts AREA_RECONCILIATION_FAILED (and test_03 asserts V2 state == COMPUTED with below-sill and above-opening surfaces)
why_it_passed_the_r8_17_freeze: the synthetic window test asserted the area of the primary form, never state == COMPUTED
fix: One wall-plane identity: every span on a wall line (wall face, window, door, sliding door, floor-reaching glazing) belongs to the plane; an opening removes exactly its rectangle clipped to [0, H]. METHOD A from the conservation pass: (sum of plane span lengths) x H - sum of rectangles + head faces. METHOD B from explicitly generated surface records: WALL_FACE (full-height spans) + BELOW_SILL (w x sill) + ABOVE_OPENING (w x (H - top)) + HEAD_FACE. Different data paths, predeclared tolerance, any mismatch -> BLOCKED; a separate reconcile() is tested against a deliberately broken surface list; every area test asserts state == COMPUTED.
